Europe.location: Main Market Square, Kraków, and Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, Poland
Europe.summary: Onet reports investigators believe the attacker may have drawn inspiration from US killer Elliot Rodger. Poland's justice minister and prosecutor general Waldemar Żurek says far-right extremism and a fascination with serial killers are the two main hypotheses in the investigation, TVN24 reports. TVP Info, citing Żurek, says the attacker had a silencer in his car boot and had searched online for Anders Breivik. PAP reports the attacker's autopsy is complete, and Notes from Poland says Prime Minister Donald Tusk has ordered an urgent review of all firearms regulations. AP, BBC, Sky News, AFP and Al Jazeera previously reported that the 24-year-old gunman, who killed six people in the Main Market Square on Saturday and nine including three family members, died in hospital; prosecutors treat it as a terrorist offence.

Oviedo has declared two days of mourning.

Europe.location: Lithuania (Druskininkai, Lazdijai and other southern districts; Kaunas) and Latvia
Europe.summary: Lithuania issued red air-attack warnings for several southern districts, including Druskininkai and Lazdijai, after unidentified objects, most likely drones, entered from Belarus, and NATO jets were scrambled from Šiauliai. Mario Nawfal, citing Lithuania's National Crisis Management Centre, says four objects were tracked, three of them in Latvian airspace, and that they were likely Ukrainian drones headed for St. Petersburg. Several accounts cite broadcaster LRT as saying Kaunas Airport suspended operations. Lithuania lifted all air alerts early on Nov. 11 local time after a suspected drone crossed the country and flew into Latvia, the head of the crisis centre told LRT radio, according to thetect0nic citing BNS. No shootdown has been reported.

threats.summary: The Justice Department says an eight-count superseding indictment unsealed Nov. 10 charges three Iranian-backed operatives with terrorism-related offenses over nearly 20 attacks and attempted attacks in the U.S. and Europe. This is a legal action on past plots, not a new attack.

Reuters reported Prime Minister Lecornu held talks over protesters' concerns, and now reports he is bringing forward a minimum-wage increase to calm protesters. Reuters separately reported an EU finding that a covert Russian network exploited the riots online.
Europe.status: Ongoing; government concession announced (Reuters); no verified new casualty or arrest totals; carried forward from 12:15 AM ET, no newer change found

Europe.status: Claim only; unverified; website DDoS, no reported port operations impact; carried forward from 12:15 AM ET, no newer change found

Europe.status: Single established outlet found on X; no injuries reported; no Garda statement found; carried forward from 12:15 AM ET, no newer change found

Europe.title: CONTINUATION: Storm Charles — Portugal shuts schools and non-essential public services Wednesday; Web Summit day cancelled, UEFA youth matches postponed, Madeira flights cancelled
Europe.summary: Portugal announced the closure of schools and non-essential public services on Nov. 11 as Storm Charles brings red wind warnings, according to Itatiaia and elsalvador.com; elsalvador.com also reports the Web Summit conference was cancelled. UEFA postponed youth club and national-team matches scheduled in Portugal for Nov. 11, per FredLine. The UK Met Office had warned of strong winds followed by heavy rain across Madeira, Portugal and Spain, with flight disruption already reported in Madeira.

Russia.title: NEW: Car bomb kills a Russian Air Force colonel in Shushary, St. Petersburg
Russia.summary: A Russian military colonel was killed on the morning of Nov. 12 when an explosive device attached under his car detonated on Kolpinskoye Highway in the Shushary area of St. Petersburg as he drove out of a residential courtyard, the @charter_97 news account and multiple monitoring accounts report. Russian media cited by these accounts identify him as the chief navigator of the 6th Air Force and Air Defense Army, but he has not been named. It is the second similar under-car bombing of an officer in the same area since late August.
Russia.status: Early reports, corroborated across multiple outlets and monitoring accounts; no official Russian statement or named victim found on X in posts checked; an early report of an injured relative was later questioned; no claim of responsibility

Russia.title: UPDATE: Russian ballistic missile and drone attack on Kyiv overnight — residential high-rise set on fire; strikes also reported in several other regions
Russia.location: Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast (Bila Tserkva, Irpin areas), Ukraine
Russia.summary: The Kyiv Independent says its journalists heard multiple explosions in Kyiv around 1 a.m. local time on Thursday (Nov. 12; about 6 p.m. ET Wednesday), shortly after Ukraine's Air Force warned that missiles were targeting the capital. OSINT account AMK Mapping says at least 11 missiles were used, including about five Iskander-Ms, and lists an Epicentr shopping center in northern Kyiv and the eastern industrial zone among the targets, with further strikes in the Bila Tserkva and Irpin areas. Journalist Oliver Carroll also reported ballistic strikes on Kyiv.
Russia.status: Early reports; casualties and damage not yet reported by Kyiv city or military administrations in posts checked; missile counts and targets come from an OSINT account and are unconfirmed; The Statesman reports Russia and Ukraine exchanged attacks on Kyiv and Moscow early Thursday, with the extent of damage in Kyiv not yet clear; Euromaidan Press, citing the Kyiv Oblast Military Administration, says a Russian drone hit a school in Yahotyn while 171 children sheltered inside, with no one hurt; casualty figures for Kyiv city still not reported in posts checked; The @xflash_media account reports a drone strike caused a fire in a nine-story residential building in Kyiv, with the fifth floor partially destroyed, and says production and warehouse sites in Kyiv Oblast were also hit; a monitoring account says Rivne, Odesa, and the Khmelnytskyi, Dnipropetrovsk and Cherkasy regions were also targeted in the combined attack; official casualty figures for Kyiv still not found in posts checked

Russia.title: CONTINUATION: Ukrainian drones attack the Omsk oil refinery in Siberia for hours; large fire reported at Russia's largest refinery
Russia.location: Omsk, Omsk Oblast, Russia (Gazprom Neft Omsk refinery)
Russia.summary: Russian local channels and multiple OSINT and media accounts report a prolonged Ukrainian drone attack on Omsk on Nov. 11, with the Gazprom Neft refinery named as the target and air defense activity lasting more than two hours. NOELreports, Liveuamap, Exilenova+ and NEXTA report the refinery is on fire, with footage of a very large blaze. The refinery is roughly 2,500 km from the front line.
Russia.status: Multiple independent accounts and footage; no official Russian statement on damage found in posts checked; Hromadske reports the Omsk regional governor confirmed a drone attack on the region but did not acknowledge a refinery strike; damage remains unclear; carried forward from 12:15 AM ET, no newer change found

Russia.title: CONTINUATION: Hackers deface Ukraine's state news agency Ukrinform and hijack its X account
Russia.summary: Ukrainian state news agency Ukrinform was hit by a cyberattack on Nov. 11: hackers defaced its website and altered its official X profile, replacing its name and imagery with anti-Ukrainian propaganda, Hromadske reports. The website was taken offline for maintenance as Ukrainian cybersecurity authorities investigated. Hungary's MTI says Ukrinform director general Serhiy Cheravatyi disclosed the attack.
Russia.status: Confirmed by Ukrinform's director general per MTI; investigation under way; no attribution announced in posts checked; carried forward from 12:15 AM ET, no newer change found

Russia.title: CONTINUATION: Russian strike on a crowded market in Chornomorsk, Odesa region, kills three and injures 11
Russia.summary: A Russian strike hit a market in central Chornomorsk on Nov. 11, killing three people and injuring 11, according to regional authorities cited by NOELreports and Ukrainian outlets. Hromadske Radio says nine of the injured were hospitalized, four in serious condition, and trading stalls were damaged and windows blown out. Early reports gave one dead before the toll rose.
Russia.status: Regional authorities report; toll rose from one to three killed during the morning; carried forward from 12:15 AM ET, no newer change found

Russia.title: CONTINUATION: Russian strike on a critical infrastructure enterprise in Dnipro kills three and injures four
Russia.summary: Suspilne, citing regional military administration head Oleksandr Hanzha, reports a Russian strike hit a critical infrastructure enterprise in Dnipro, killing two people, injuring at least four and starting a fire. Hromadske Radio later reported the toll rose to three, with businesses and a private home also damaged and four men hospitalized, two in serious condition. CGTN Europe, citing Ukraine's health service, reports three killed and five injured across Dnipropetrovsk region during the day.
Russia.status: Official (regional military administration) figures relayed by Ukrainian outlets; emergency services at the scene; facility not named; carried forward from 12:15 AM ET, no newer change found

Russia.location: Odesa Oblast (Mayaky, Zatoka, Artsyz), Kharkiv and Chernihiv, Ukraine

Russia.location: Dnipropetrovsk region (Dnipro, Pavlohrad, Kamianske and other communities), Ukraine; also Kharkiv and Zhytomyr regions
Russia.summary: Ukrinform reports Energy Minister Denys Shmyhal said the power supply situation remains especially difficult in Kyiv and Dnipro. NV reports President Zelensky raised the difficult electricity, water and heating situation in Kyiv, Dnipro and Kherson with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen. Zelensky said earlier that more than 600,000 customers in the Dnipropetrovsk region were without power at the peak after strikes, and that supply was gradually being restored. Ukraine's Center for Strategic Communications says Russian forces attacked four districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 20 times overnight.

AMK Mapping says at least 16 Geran-2 drones were used and that the "Pivdenna" and "Hirnycha" 330 kV substations on the city's southern outskirts were hit.

He said 146 drones were intercepted over the region as of 7:30 a.m. local time and that there was no information on casualties. Earlier OSINT footage showed the oil terminal burning.

America.status: Official statement issued (FDNY, Mayor); outlets citing Mayor Mamdani put the injured at 19, including seven children; 1010 WINS says hundreds of FDNY members were still searching the rubble Wednesday night; cause not established in posts checked

threats.title: CONTINUATION: US indictment of three Iranian-backed operatives over nearly 20 plots — prosecutors say suspects planned to use fuel-carrying vans near RAF Fairford before UK authorities intervened
threats.location: United States; Europe; RAF Fairford, Gloucestershire, England
threats.summary: The Justice Department says an eight-count superseding indictment unsealed Nov. 10 charges three Iranian-backed operatives with terrorism-related offenses over nearly 20 attacks and attempted attacks in the U.S. and Europe. The charges include a September 2026 plot at RAF Fairford in the UK, where U.S. military aircraft and personnel are stationed. The FBI's New York and Washington field offices announced the case. This is a legal action on past plots, not a new attack.
threats.status: Official statement issued (Justice Department, FBI); charges are allegations; defendants presumed innocent; carried forward from 10:15 PM ET, no newer change found
